threatModel.goal: Prevent accidental memory disclosure or mutation between tenants sharing one OS process and carrier pthreads

requirements.tenantReferences: Untrusted code cannot manufacture, receive or dereference a raw native pointer to tenant or host memory; compiler-generated loads and stores are confined to the current tenant and actor allocation by validated guest-memory addressing, including overflow-safe effective-address arithmetic
requirements.scope: Every mutable object, actor state, heap allocation and resource handle belongs to one root, tenant generation and actor/transfer authority; a matching tenant name or reused numeric slot alone confers no authority
requirements.actorMemory: Actors within a tenant cannot access other actors' mutable allocations except through a compiler-checked ownership or synchronization mechanism; untrusted guest memory loads remain actor-bounded
requirements.borrow: A borrowed or mutable reference cannot cross a TenantVM boundary, escape its valid lifetime through a continuation or survive owner retirement; failing static proof is a compilation error
requirements.copy: Cross-tenant message payloads are validated values; copy!! deep-copies reachable mutable data, including nested data and repeated/cyclic references, or rejects unsupported graphs, without retaining sender-owned backing storage
requirements.take: take! does not export a raw writable native pointer across tenant VMs; transfer requires a trusted, atomic and generation-fenced owner change with all aliases revoked, or a validated copy; otherwise reject
requirements.share: share! is not implicit; any cross-tenant sharing must be immutable and backed by memory the receiver cannot mutate, or copied; sharing mutable raw backing storage is rejected
requirements.hostApi: Host API validates every guest offset, length and target against the current actor and tenant before touching memory; integer overflow, OOB, forged and stale handles fail closed
requirements.carriers: A carrier handoff clears or rebinds guest TLS, tenant heap base, root/actor authority and borrowed references; no stale context is reused after a turn, exception, suspension, cancellation or tenant switch
requirements.lifetime: Retirement prevents fresh admissions, waits for or safely terminates executing carriers and drains host-owned resource loans before unmapping or returning quotas; stale handles stay invalid
requirements.scrubbing: Memory and pooled message buffers are sanitized before reuse by a different tenant; tenant-local uninitialized reads are forbidden by compiler/runtime semantics
requirements.admission: Untrusted guests must come from a validated, confinement-enforcing producer (e.g. Wasm engine or proved lowering, or an actual Graal isolate); no fallback to raw native/CIL/FFI execution

promotion.rule: This manifest and its Node tests prove schema consistency only; no backend may report untrusted TenantVM memory isolation without compiled guest negative tests and executed exact-tree CI
